a smooth isolated rational curve with the required normal zero modes
curve_lift_theorem.projected_case: For a rational curve C_tilde in X6 projecting to C in K3, the pullback principal T2 bundle over C must admit a section.
curve_lift_theorem.vertical_case: A nonconstant holomorphic P1 cannot map into a complex torus fiber, so a rational instanton curve cannot be purely vertical.

direct_strong_CP_decoupling.global_result: min V=min_b W_worldsheet(b), and every global minimum can have theta_QCD=0 exactly
direct_strong_CP_decoupling.minimization: For every fixed b, primitive periodic theta_MI sets theta_MI+3d dot b+theta_bar=0 mod 2pi.
direct_strong_CP_decoupling.scope: This conclusion fails when a hidden-gauge, NS5, or other term with a nonzero theta_MI charge is present.

minimal_Picard_stratum.conditional_premise: Picard rank is the minimum 1+r generated over Q by the ample class H and the rank-r torus Chern span, with H orthogonal to that span.
minimal_Picard_stratum.deduction: The common algebraic orthogonal of the torus Chern classes is the positive H line, so it contains no class of square -2 and hence no smooth rational K3 curve that can lift.

theorem.name: FuYauRationalCurveLiftNecessaryCondition
theorem.statement: Every rational worldsheet instanton curve in a principal T2 Fu-Yau total space projects to a K3 rational curve annihilated by both torus Chern classes. A nonzero superpotential term further requires isolation and a vanishing H0 kernel for V|C tensor O(-1). Independently of its amplitude, a worldsheet-only potential cannot displace the QCD angle because the primitive surviving model-independent axion can minimize the QCD term for every fixed model-dependent configuration.

zero_mode_gate.vanishing_criterion: H0(C,V|C tensor O_C(-1)) is nonzero implies Pfaff_C=0
